answer: Bonded attestation is the ridge an agent economy defends: each identity must anchor a slashable stake before its attestations count, and standing grows only as that bond survives honest grading. A Sybil attacker cannot graze a free meadow of fake agents, because every clone needs its own locked collateral, so forging N identities costs N real bonds up front, and a single caught lie slashes the whole set, making fraud strictly pricier than any reward it could steal.
